name: Noadiah
description: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return

points: Nehemiah asks the Most High to think upon Tobiah, Sanballat, the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets who would have put him in fear according to their works.

note.label: Nehemiah 6: The Wall Finished Against the Enemies' Plots

points: “My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works”: he prays to God to deal with these evil people, “and on the prophetess Noadiah”, a black woman who joined with them, “and the rest of the prophets”, the false prophets who tried to put him in fear and make him stop rebuilding Jerusalem.

note.label: THE BLACK BOULÉ & BOURGEOISIE IN THE BIBLE

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Sanballat, Geshem, and Noadiah
cases.charge: Laughing the work to scorn; conspiring to fight against Jerusalem; sending four times to draw Nehemiah to the plain of Ono to do him mischief; an open letter charging rebellion; hiring Shemaiah and the prophetess Noadiah to put him in fear
cases.preview: Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian were grieved that a man had come to seek the welfare of Israel;
